phrases.latin: Estne avis, tata? Cūr tanta est? — Avis est, gallopāvō, avis Americāna, quae tanta crēscit.
phrases.english: Is it a bird, Dad? Why is it so big? — It’s a bird, a turkey, an American bird that grows this big.

phrases.latin: avia gallopāvōnem in furnum mīsit, quem jam fartō complēverat
phrases.english: Grandma put the turkey in the oven; she had already filled it with stuffing

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: pp. 145, 399, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.
